evidence: Walked all 55 criteria (2 render/constraints gate, 43 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual likert). Scripted golden on these exact solution bytes (project tree identical to the frozen task by diff -r; bundle rebuilt 2026-10-08 11:27; results/editor.json, runtime.json, persist-before.json, persist-after.json, polish.json) reports true for every gate, all 43 functional and all 6 polish criterion ids plus a layout proxy; all 19 raw-evidence hashes re-verified. Gates, polish, visual and prompts are byte-unchanged since v15 (git diff 0829983e..HEAD touches only the brief, app_context and 7 functional criteria) and the solution is unchanged, so the hosted v15 Oracle (kTaeUNx reward.json: render 1, constraints 1, functional 1, polish 1, visual 1) is direct evidence for those dimensions; nop scored 0. Where the scripted check is weaker than the v16 wording I confirmed the golden in source: (a) cw_save_reload_restart restores via a direct fetch in persist.cjs:70-71 rather than the UI, but the UI sends POST /api/snippets/:id/restore with {revision, sourceRevision, operationId} (app.tsx:85) and the server stores operationIds in the SQLite restore_operations table and returns the prior result on replay (server.js:102-105,114-115,163-166), so a replay after a real restart adds no revision; cw_restore_request_repeat_safe additionally replays the UI-captured request (persist.cjs:128-138). (b) cw_last_good_recovery scripts only the error leg for input value + canvas pixel (runtime.cjs:124-133), but Stop and the 5.1 s watchdog use the same rollback path as error (runtime.ts:378-380 vs 405), and time-limit/Stop restoring the prior picture is scripted at runtime.cjs:146,149,162. (c) cw_dynamic_code_refused with split payload halves and async WebAssembly.compile: refusal is by the preview CSP without unsafe-eval/wasm-unsafe-eval, worker-src 'none', plus an AST block on ImportExpression and a securitypolicyviolation handler that reports a visible reason (runtime.ts:7,50-51,220-226), independent of payload text. (d) cw_js_semantic_coloring plain-name distinction is not asserted (editor.cjs:266,272 'void plain'), but plain identifiers receive no tok- class while keyword/function/string/number/comment have five distinct colours/weights (style.css:25-29; custom-editor.js:141-146 colours declared and called function names alike). (e) cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft baseline and cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state undo: typing groups break on caret moves (custom-editor.js:574-583), so a marker typed after moving is its own Undo step. No criterion quotes seeded figures or arithmetic the golden cannot produce. Risk stays true because no configured-judge (claude-code + glm-5.3-flashx) Oracle run exists on these v16 bytes: 7 functional criteria changed after the v15 Oracle 1.0 (output_before_failure_kept, last_good_recovery, stop_cancels_pending_work, newer_run_supersedes, preview_isolation, save_reload_restart, history_restore_adds_revision), and the new up-to-three-attempt Stop/newer-Run retries plus the expanded restart check lengthen a 43-criterion batched functional judge at timeout 9000 s whose completion was not measured on v16. Scripted Playwright passes are not judge scores; no Oracle or portal score is claimed.
